rationale: Round 0 built and ran correctly, so this round pushes obfuscation strength up while guarding the hot numeric kernels (advance, energy) that dominate n-body runtime. SUB is weighted highest for SecurityGain/DiversityGain because arithmetic obfuscation is nearly free at runtime and thrives on this program's dense floating-point and integer computations; IGV follows since the solar-system initial-state data and loop constants are prime reverse-engineering anchors and its overhead is loop-hoistable. BCF and IBR are raised to strong-but-moderate levels to obscure control flow without compounding per-iteration overhead inside the innermost loops, while FLA is held slightly lower with a higher RuntimeCost weight because flattening a tight numeric loop costs the most on this profile. SPLIT and ICALL stay as cheap, low-risk diversity boosters across the five small functions. All CorrectnessRisk weights remain low, prioritizing that the binary keeps validating after a clean round-0 build.
